moves.label: Close port USLAX (Port of Los Angeles)
moves.rationale: Closing the Port of Los Angeles will immediately disrupt a significant number of exporters and cause a substantial capability loss.

moves.label: Reroute exports away from port USLAX (Port of Los Angeles)
moves.rationale: Rerouting exports from the closed Port of Los Angeles to other open ports will immediately reduce the capability loss.

moves.label: Outage at facility FAC02801 (Ulvane Volans Industries Ltd - Barrow)
moves.rationale: Targeting a single point of failure in the deep network will maximize disruption and create lasting pressure.

moves.label: Replace the production of facility FAC02801 (Ulvane Volans Industries Ltd - Barrow)
moves.rationale: Replacing the facility will recover the most immediate loss and prevent further degradation from this specific failure.

moves.label: Close port USHOU (Port of Houston)
moves.rationale: Targeting the Port of Houston will disrupt a significant number of exporters and add substantial loss.

moves.label: Reroute exports away from port USHOU (Port of Houston)
moves.rationale: Rerouting exports from the recently closed Port of Houston will significantly reduce the current capability loss.
